Rae (Marketing): Quick brainstorm: 20-minute "flash lab" for devs — live build + benchmark table + a 50-credit catalyst. Goal: convert console triers to active users. Thoughts?
Diego (Growth): Sounds great. Short format reduces drop-off. Recommend 2 prompts only: one app-facing, one infra/debug. Grant 20 credits on signup, 30 after checklist.
Zoe (Product): We can pre-load two prompt templates in the console and show estimated token cost & latency inline during demo. That benchmark narrative will be our main CTA.
Lina (Onboarding): Checklist idea: 1) create API key, 2) run first prompt, 3) save a prompt. Unlock 30 credits on completion. Keep copy tiny.
Amit (Ops): Routing: demo traffic -> pool "flashlab-demo"; fallback "hosted-standard". Soft qps guard for new IPs. Also set per-user promo cap = 50, expire in 28 days.
Rae (Marketing): Landing copy draft: "Build a live feature in 20 minutes — see real latency & cost, get 50 credits to ship." Short subhead + CTA.
Diego (Growth): Experiment arms: A) 50 upfront, B) 20+30 gated, holdout 25%. Measure signup->first-run, attendance, 7-day retention, credit usage.
Zoe (Product): Prompt packs: "Feature blurb generator" + "Error explainer". Each has 1 example with token estimate. We'll instrument per-prompt metrics for the post-event benchmark email.
Lina (Onboarding): UI: modal shows progress and credit balance after unlock. Who owns modal build? @Zoe
Zoe (Product): I'll build it and add a small success animation. Lina, send final checklist text by EOD.
Amit (Ops): Pseudo-route snippet:
```nroute:
  cohort: flashlab-apr
  pool: flashlab-demo
  fallback: hosted-standard
  max_qps: 70
```n
Rae (Marketing): Promo channels: in-app banner, seed cohort email, tiny LinkedIn push. Publish a short benchmark note same day with the table.
Diego (Growth): Tracking: landing CVR, attendance %, first API call within 24h, retained callers at day7/day30, cost-per-activated-user.
Scheduler Bot: Event scheduled: "Flash Lab: 20m build + credits" on 2026-04-22 16:00 UTC. Attendees: Rae, Diego, Zoe, Amit, Lina.
Rae (Marketing): Action items: Rae = landing + assets, Diego = experiment wiring, Zoe = modal + metrics, Lina = checklist + onboarding content, Amit = route + caps. Reconvene after drafts. Thanks! :sparkles:
